svg.title: The method: every turn reduces the size of the bet
svg.desc: A single line falls from the top left to the bottom right. It begins where three questions — desirable, feasible, viable — converge into one bet worth making. It then passes through four repeating moves: listen, structure, prove, land. Each move sits lower than the last, and each drops a dotted line to a baseline marked "ends in front of a real user", so the bet a stakeholder has to accept gets smaller every turn. Past a dashed marker reading "ship", the line keeps falling through smaller turns, because shipping is the first honest data and the loops do not stop.
svg.text: Every turn reduces the size of the bet.
HEIGHT = HOW BIG A BET SOMEONE ELSE HAS TO ACCEPT
EVERY TURN ENDS IN FRONT OF A REAL USER — THAT IS WHAT MAKES THE NEXT BET SMALLER
ALL THREE, OR IT DIES IN REVIEW

g.text: = ONE TURN: LISTEN, STRUCTURE, PROVE, LAND

svg.text: RESEARCH IS A RHYTHM, NOT A PHASE
SHIPPING IS THE FIRST HONEST DATA
